To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the research methodology has evolved from a focus on the development of language standards and tools towards a more pragmatic approach that focuses on the development of systems that are able to solve real-world problems, (2) the Semantic Web Community is now more focused on the development of applications that are able to process large amounts of data and (3) the Semantic Web Language Standards are now more mature and are able to express more complex semantics.
